title: atomicstrata/llm-wiki-compiler
claim: atomicstrata/llm-wiki-compiler — The knowledge compiler. Raw sources in, interlinked wiki out. Inspired by Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern.
why_good: Compiles raw sources into an interlinked wiki (Karpathy's 'LLM wiki' pattern) — turns doc piles into navigable knowledge automatically.
value: Charge teams for hosted compilation + private knowledge bases; the wedge is quality of auto-structuring at scale.
risk: Same crowded AI-knowledge-base lane as other LLM-wiki tools; auto-linking alone isn't a durable moat.
pick_reason: The project offers a clear product for structured knowledge management that organizations can implement and pay for.

zh.claim: atomicstrata/llm-wiki-compiler —— 知识编译器:原始素材进,互链 wiki 出。灵感来自 Karpathy 的 LLM Wiki。
zh.why_good: 把原始素材编译成互链 wiki(Karpathy 的 LLM wiki 范式)——自动把文档堆变成可导航的知识。
zh.value: 向团队卖托管编译 + 私有知识库;切口是规模化自动结构化的质量。
zh.risk: 和其它 LLM-wiki 工具同一条拥挤赛道;光自动互链不是持久护城河。
